method.build: Vite production, exact GitHub Pages path prefix
method.network: Browser offline AND fixture server HTTP 503
method.restart: Entire persistent browser process closed and relaunched with same user data directory

steps: online install: complete cache before visiting any lazy scene
entire browser process closed; same profile reopened with browser offline and server 503
first offline flower sea: pick lily and save
first offline candy workshop: select recipe, stir 8 times, cook 3 rounds, receive saved candy
first offline cabin/editor: touch-move existing chair and flip, save placement
first offline ruins: cast light, walk to chest, obtain treasure, walk back to stairs
offline lake lazy module, meteor and dawn playback/skip, progress and original named star preserved
offline independent aurora page and saved flower sea return
save/exit, close entire browser, offline restart preserves all profile systems
downloaded new version does not refresh during candy making or furniture placement
failed localStorage write blocks activation and reload
other open window blocks activation; user-approved online update preserves save and foreign cache
JSON download, invalid-file rejection, import preview/cancel, confirmed replacement with original backup
failurePaths: 503 on a never-visited lazy candy chunk rejects whole install; no offline-ready claim or save reset
retry after failed initial Service Worker install prepares complete release
missing cached editor detected while offline; incomplete status instead of false success
Workbox repair downloads missing editor and verifies complete cache again
preview worker does not control formal path; no docs, screenshots, legacy originals or foreign-origin content cached
unreadable old save stays byte-for-byte through reload; explicit preview/confirm restores it and preserves original raw backup

publishedRelease.status: Verified on public GitHub Pages in Chromium and WebKit: complete cache and offline main/meadow/aurora round trip

limitations: Native iOS Add to Home Screen dialogs and actual iPhone OS process/storage policies are not verified by desktop WebKit.
Safari and a Home Screen app can use different storage containers. Export before installing; verify ready in the installed app too.
First preparation needs a network. Clearing website data or OS storage eviction requires re-preparation.
Cache totals describe decoded cached response bodies of one release, excluding browser overhead and the separately stored service worker. Safe updates retain one previous complete release.

testNotes: One WebKit timing assertion in the unchanged 180 ms joystick regression failed while builds and browser suites shared the machine; the unchanged suite passed in an isolated rerun. No movement code or assertion threshold was changed.
